Two browser checks (recap-shows-written-lenses-and-facts, results-tour-spotlights-peer-table) failed on first attempt due to test-script issues (uppercase CSS text-transform on facts labels; force:true clicking a stale position during a layout-animated tour pill) and passed cleanly after fixing the check scripts -- classified as test-authoring fixes, not app bugs, and reran to green.

action_items.detail: Two pre-existing backend test files unrelated to this iteration's acceptance_matrix failed when the full suite was run: test_tscheck_rate_limit_wall.py::test_fourth_submission_hits_daily_wall (depends on the shared 3/day quota already being exhausted by an earlier browser run this session -- flaky-by-design against shared external state) and test_tscheck_share_link_preview.py::test_share_link_preview_has_og_tags_and_redirect (asserts an old '&view=recap&shared=1' redirect query string the share page no longer emits -- a stale assertion from a prior iteration's feature, not part of this briefing's matrix). checks.criterion: Peer comparison table replaces the old quality lenses section on the results page, directly after the price section
checks.name: peer-table-replaces-quality-lenses
checks.evidence: On /?idea=2a3c3928...&shared=1 (tour flags pre-set), peer-section renders after performance-section (DOM order check), peer-prompt text matches exactly 'Is this company's edge real, or is the whole sector this good? Compare ROE, ROCE and margins within each group.'. 0 [data-testid^=category-card-] elements, 0 '[class*=pip]' elements, no '#N rank' or 'x / 5' text anywhere on the page. Re-ran successfully against the public ingress URL https://idea-to-ticker.preview.emergentagent.com too.

checks.criterion: One combined table: each discovered company is a highlighted row with its validated peers grouped below; 10 sourced columns
checks.name: peer-table-columns-and-sourcing
checks.evidence: peer-row-britannia/balramchin/uflex plus peer-row-nestleind/itc/renuka/huhtamaki all visible. All 10 peer-metric-* column headers present (market_cap, pe_ratio, roe, roce, operating_margin, net_income, operating_cash_flow, revenue_growth, debt_to_equity, price_change_1y); ROCE header tagged 'calculated'. Britannia's ROE cell renders '—' (missing-value em dash, matches spec deviation that ROE is never estimated). At least one cell carries the loss-tone class for a negative figure. peer-source text equals 'Yahoo Finance · may be delayed or incomplete · ROCE calculated from annual figures'.

checks.name: peer-table-mobile-interactions
checks.evidence: At 390px viewport, document.scrollWidth<=391 (no page overflow); peer-swipe-hint visible on first view (localStorage hint key cleared); inner peer-table-scroll has overflow-x auto (sideways scroll isolated from the page). Tapping peer-metric-roce opens peer-explainer with a working peer-explainer-close button. Tapping peer-reason-toggle-nestleind reveals peer-reason-nestleind containing 'why it's a rival'. Tapping peer-open-britannia navigates to company-detail-page showing 'Britannia' in detail-company-name.

checks.name: financials-tab-shows-cashflow-comparison

Clicking financials-toggle-revenue opens financials-years-revenue containing FY-labelled rows. financials-lesson (teaching sentence) is visible. financials-source text contains 'Yahoo Finance · annual reported figures · may be delayed or incomplete'.
